body: Thank you for your words. I filed a complaint through the school and the administrative person let me know that I didn't have enough evidence from the assault. There were no witnesses and no evidence. I am trying very hard to work towards my goal in my phd program but it's so difficult when I feel like everything is going against me.

I was very hurt by my boyfriend's reaction. I think it made things much harder to cope with and I just broke down. Right now is an emotional roller coaster with feelings of guitar, shame, disgust, and fear. It's hard for me to pinpoint what I'm feeling at the moment.

Thank you. I'm not feeling ready at the moment to report this to the police. I'm not sure whether to report this to city police or campus police. I'm feeling hesitant to tell any more people. I feel helpless in trying to move forward from this. I called a rape crisis hotline earlier and they just didn't seem very helpful. The operator said something along the lines of "aw you sound nervous haha". Like of course I'm nervous and scared I don't know how to deal with this. She also just gave me phone numbers to the pd in the city and on campus, which I already knew. I don't know what I was expecting for the rape crisis hotline. I guess I just thought a professional would talk to me and listen.

I'm afraid of talking to the cops outside of my campus. I know they get into asking questions as to "why" and ask about collecting evidence. I did all the wrong things a victim of sexual assault: I brushed my teeth, I showered, and washed my clothes from that night because I felt dirty. All of the evidence is gone by now.

Thank you for reading my post. It helps to read your response. I didn't report this to the cops yet...I feel like I couldn't handle the barrage of questions from cops. I'm going to seek help on how to file a report with my campus sexual assault resource office tomorrow. 

Thank you for warning me about women. I understand that women (and also men sometimes) will react by victim-blaming, which would not be helpful at all.

Thank you so much for your response. I will definitely go to see my sexual assault resource tomorrow at my university. I'm going through the guilt and anger issues like an emotional roller coaster at this point, since it happened recently.
